high_risk_moment: Automated resume scoring prior to recruiter review
harm_description: Historical male-dominated hiring data caused model to downgrade resumes with gender-correlated terms leading to systemic candidate penalization
proposed_controls: Demographic parity debiasing in training dataset and blind resume parser evaluation
human_oversight: Recruiters must manually review all applicant files and cannot execute automated rejection
monitoring_metric: Demographic adverse impact ratio (four-fifths rule score)
trigger_threshold: Impact ratio below 0.80 for any protected demographic group
response_action: Pause AI recommendation service immediately and revert recruiters to manual chronological review queue

high_risk_moment: Keyword extraction and qualification eligibility scoring
harm_description: Resume parser systematically fails to recognize non-standard formatting or unconventional job titles resulting in structurally biased scoring that misclassifies qualified candidates from non-traditional backgrounds
proposed_controls: Structured evidence extraction displaying original resume snippets alongside match scores to recruiters
human_oversight: Recruiters review original resume text alongside AI qualification extraction before finalizing shortlist
trigger_threshold: Recruiter score override rate exceeding 25% of candidate recommendations
response_action: Trigger prompt tuning and re-evaluate resume extraction parser accuracy on non-standard resume formats
